t.zh: 拍摄同一场景时，有的镜头能容纳更宽的景物，有的只能拍到局部。有限大小的<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>只接收部分<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>。固定传感器高度，改变<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>并观察两条边界：怎样使<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>恰好为 90°？
t.en: Different lenses capture different amounts of the same scene. A finite <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> receives only some <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>. Keep its height fixed and change the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> while observing the two boundaries: how can the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> be exactly 90°?

after.zh: 图中两条边界同时向<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>收拢，说明固定画幅下，放大投影会舍去更多外围场景。这里用<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>描述这个取舍；全角必须同时包含上、下两半。
after.en: Both boundary rays close toward the axis: for a fixed frame, enlarging the projection excludes more of the surrounding scene. <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> describes that trade-off; the full angle includes both halves. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

brief.zh: <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 24 mm；本实验只看竖直方向。调 f，让全视场为 90°；用上下两条边界<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>核对，不要只看上半角。
brief.en: The <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is 24 mm tall and this experiment uses a vertical slice. Set f for a full field of view of 90°. Check both boundary rays rather than only the upper half-angle. (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)

hint.zh: 全角是 90° 时，上半角是多少？在等比例图里，f 与<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>半高怎样比较？
hint.en: For a full angle of 90°, what is the upper half-angle? In the equal-scale drawing, how does f compare with the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> half-height?

why.zh: 把全高当作半高时，边界<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的夹角不再是 45°。检查后看全角与半角两个读数。
why.en: Using the full height as the half-height does not give a 45° edge <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>. After checking compare the full and half-angle readings. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)
